page.overview:
What is Absolite?

Absolite belongs to Pokémon. Certain Pokémon will be able to Mega Evolve while holding the respective Mega Stone or, in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!

and Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee!, having the respective Mega Stone present in the Bag. However, the Pokémon will revert back to their pre-Mega-Evolved form after the battle or when the Pokémon faints. Rayquaza is the only Pokémon that doesn't require a Mega Stone to evolve.
